summary: Added email preference storage and management system. Extended storage.js with EMAIL_PREFERENCES key and per-user getter/setter functions (email, unsubscribe_status, snooze_until fields). Created src/utils/email-preferences.js with getEmailPreferences, updateEmail, setUnsubscribed, setSnoozePeriod, shouldSendReminder, and validateEmail functions including auto-expiry of snooze periods. Created api/email-preferences.js POST endpoint with early-return validation for userId, email format, authentication, and action routing (update_email, set_unsubscribed, set_snooze, get_preferences) following existing try-catch error handling patterns.
